title: Did your sign change? No.
caption:
Heard your sign changed? Earth's axis wobbles slowly, so the stars behind the Sun have shifted. Western astrology ties signs to the seasons; sidereal ties them to the stars.
Your sign stayed. Send this to the friend who panicked.
